history.summary: A liquid, rental-grade 829 sqft 2BR at $1,688 psf — a sizeable 14% below the $1,954 median — in a 2017 development 450m from Aljunied MRT (East-West Line). Exceptional liquidity (347 URA transactions) and a strong rental location offset a modest 4.2%/yr appreciation and only basic finishes. A pragmatic income-and-exit play rather than a capital-growth star.
history.rating_rationale: The standout is liquidity: 347 transactions is the deepest in the batch, so exit risk is minimal, and the $1.4M price sits squarely in the liquid band. PSF is meaningfully below median (1,688 vs 1,954), and Aljunied (EW9) + city-fringe location drives genuinely strong rental demand. Tempered by the lowest appreciation in the batch (4.2%/yr, below RCR baseline despite D14), basic material quality per reviews, small bedrooms, and audible jet-engine noise. A solid Buy for yield + easy exit, not a growth pick.
red_flags: Lowest appreciation in batch at 4.2%/yr — below the RCR ~5.8% baseline
Reviews cite basic materials/fittings and small bedrooms
Aircraft/jet-engine noise reported (Paya Lebar flight path) and congestion at entry/exit at peak
Some resident complaints on management/security (parcel theft)
catalysts: 450m to EW9 Aljunied MRT — direct city-fringe access drives durable rental demand
Paya Lebar Central proximity and airbase relocation (~2030) support medium-term D14 upside
Very deep transaction liquidity (347 URA txns) minimizes exit risk

agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale-only CAGR on a large 347-txn sample — taken at face value

history.summary: Well-located RCR-fringe unit (829 sqft is a 3BR-compact, not a 2BR) priced near the closest comp and below the project average, with a strong Paya Lebar transformation catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: The 829 sqft layout is actually Sims Urban Oasis' 3-bedroom Compact (818-829 sqft), so the dossier's '2 beds' undercounts its utility. Asking $1,688 psf is roughly in line with the most-comparable recent 829 sqft sale (~$1,605 psf) and well under the project-wide last-12-month average of ~$1,945 psf (range $1,499-$2,226), supporting the -12.7% age-adj / -15.5% cohort signals on a deep 41-txn cohort and 347-txn appreciation base. GuocoLand-built, 1,024 units, 2017, walkable to Aljunied MRT and the Paya Lebar Central regional-centre redevelopment.
red_flags: Documented traffic noise; towers facing Aljunied Road junction / PIE should be avoided and could cap resale
Asking $1,688 psf is slightly above the closest 829 sqft comp (~$1,605) so the immediate discount is modest, not deep
Geylang/Sims fringe carries a perception discount versus core D14 Katong/Joo Chiat
catalysts: Paya Lebar Central regional-centre transformation (offices, retail, URA master plan) lifts the micro-market
Walkable to Aljunied MRT (EWL); large GuocoLand project with strong rental track record
829 sqft 3BR-compact entry at $1.4M is an efficient family/rental layout for the location
